title: Keep API Wall, REST v2, and MCP as distinct interfaces
description: Maintain separate public interface roles for benchmark chat, service integration, and agent-host discovery.
source_customers: TRA; iAIMS; Skill Factory; SCM Cognitive Sandwich; Maritime Port Sandbox; SCM-Cert-Bench
acceptance_evidence: Docs and implementation preserve separate API Wall, REST v2, and MCP entrypoints.
notes: Do not turn API Wall into MCP.

title: Expose read-heavy MCP memory query
description: Provide discoverable scoped memory query for MCP clients.
source_customers: TRA; iAIMS; Skill Factory; SCM Cognitive Sandwich; Maritime Port Sandbox; SCM-Cert-Bench
acceptance_evidence: MCP client can discover and call structured memory query.

title: Expose MCP context assembly
description: Provide context bundle assembly with evidence and provenance.
source_customers: TRA; iAIMS; Skill Factory; SCM Cognitive Sandwich; Maritime Port Sandbox; SCM-Cert-Bench
acceptance_evidence: Response includes context items, evidence, provenance, warnings, and size metadata.

title: Preserve REST v2 for backend and batch integrations
description: Keep REST v2 available for non-agent runtime, ingestion, scripts, and test harnesses.
source_customers: TRA; iAIMS; Skill Factory; Maritime Port Sandbox; SCM-Cert-Bench
acceptance_evidence: REST v2 remains documented and tested independently of MCP.
notes: SCM Cognitive Sandwich does not require REST for MVP.

title: Provide scoped L2 fact store and retrieve
description: Store and retrieve working-memory facts with scope and provenance.
source_customers: TRA; iAIMS; Skill Factory; SCM-Cert-Bench
acceptance_evidence: Writes return fact ids; reads enforce scope.

title: Provide L3 episode assimilation/store
description: Persist episodes, repairs, generation attempts, simulations, and feedback history.
source_customers: TRA; iAIMS; Skill Factory; SCM Cognitive Sandwich; Maritime Port Sandbox; SCM-Cert-Bench
acceptance_evidence: Write returns episode id and audit metadata; episode is retrievable by scope.

title: Provide L3 semantic episode query
description: Retrieve similar episodes with ranking metadata and provenance.
source_customers: TRA; iAIMS; SCM Cognitive Sandwich; Maritime Port Sandbox; SCM-Cert-Bench
acceptance_evidence: Query returns scoped ranked episodes with provenance.
notes: Skill Factory covers similar behavior through generation history.

title: Provide L4 final artifact/document storage
description: Store verified final artifacts, reports, and durable knowledge documents.
source_customers: TRA; iAIMS; Skill Factory; SCM Cognitive Sandwich
acceptance_evidence: Finalization returns knowledge id and source metadata.
notes: Maritime focuses on simulation evidence but also benefits.

title: Return provenance on all reads and writes
description: Return source tier, source id, timestamp, producer, and scope metadata.
source_customers: TRA; iAIMS; Skill Factory; SCM Cognitive Sandwich; Maritime Port Sandbox; SCM-Cert-Bench
acceptance_evidence: Public responses include provenance for memory ids.

title: Enforce session/task/tenant/run scoping
description: Protect memory reads and writes with explicit scope boundaries.
source_customers: TRA; iAIMS; Skill Factory; SCM Cognitive Sandwich; Maritime Port Sandbox; SCM-Cert-Bench
acceptance_evidence: Cross-session and cross-tenant reads are blocked unless explicitly allowed.

title: Keep default MCP resources read-only
description: MCP resources are inspection surfaces and must not mutate state.
source_customers: iAIMS; Skill Factory; SCM Cognitive Sandwich; Maritime Port Sandbox; SCM-Cert-Bench
acceptance_evidence: MCP resources cannot mutate memory state.

title: Allowlist mutating and lifecycle MCP tools
description: Require explicit permission for write and lifecycle tools.
source_customers: TRA; iAIMS; Skill Factory; SCM Cognitive Sandwich; Maritime Port Sandbox; SCM-Cert-Bench
acceptance_evidence: Write/lifecycle tool availability is controlled server-side.

title: Never expose secrets, raw env, or sensitive traces through resources
description: Redact secrets, database URLs, raw env values, raw reasoning traces, and unredacted logs.
source_customers: iAIMS; Skill Factory; SCM Cognitive Sandwich; Maritime Port Sandbox; SCM-Cert-Bench
acceptance_evidence: Permission tests verify restricted data is denied or redacted.
notes: Also aligned with repo secret boundary.

title: Propagate trace context and expose Phoenix-auditable operations
description: Trace memory reads, writes, evidence aggregation, and agentic reviews.
source_customers: TRA; iAIMS; Skill Factory; SCM Cognitive Sandwich; Maritime Port Sandbox; SCM-Cert-Bench
acceptance_evidence: Calls propagate trace context and emit auditable spans.
notes: Use W3C trace context where applicable.

title: Provide health and configuration inspection
description: Expose health and configured/degraded/unavailable tier status without secrets.
source_customers: iAIMS; Skill Factory; SCM Cognitive Sandwich; Maritime Port Sandbox; SCM-Cert-Bench
acceptance_evidence: Health/config resource reports tier status without secret exposure.

title: Provide Evidence Table generation
description: Generate structured evidence rows for audits, repairs, skills, and disputed runs.
source_customers: iAIMS; Skill Factory; SCM Cognitive Sandwich; Maritime Port Sandbox; SCM-Cert-Bench
acceptance_evidence: Evidence Table includes claim, source, provenance, policy metadata, visibility, and warnings.
notes: Runtime-critical for some customers, audit-only for others.

title: Provide CIAR explanation with components and policy metadata
description: Explain CIAR scores, policy status, review-only state, and suppression metadata.
source_customers: TRA; iAIMS; Skill Factory; Maritime Port Sandbox; SCM-Cert-Bench
acceptance_evidence: Explanation includes certainty, impact, age decay, recency boost, final score, and policy version.

title: Return partial results with warnings for degraded agentic services
description: Return raw/unified evidence when agentic evidence or CIAR services degrade.
source_customers: iAIMS; Skill Factory; Maritime Port Sandbox; SCM-Cert-Bench
acceptance_evidence: Read responses can report partial results and warnings without mutation.

title: Support artifact draft/revision/feedback/commit lineage
description: Represent iterative artifact repair lineage with feedback and commit nodes.
source_customers: SCM Cognitive Sandwich
acceptance_evidence: Lineage captures artifact, revisions, feedback, commits, hashes, and verification states.

title: Provide artifact lineage resources
description: Expose read-only artifact lineage resources for inspection and repair context.
source_customers: SCM Cognitive Sandwich
acceptance_evidence: Resource returns ordered lineage nodes with provenance and redacted payload behavior.

title: Store deterministic feedback and solver/sandbox evidence
description: Persist external deterministic feedback and benchmark judge evidence as linked evidence.
source_customers: SCM Cognitive Sandwich; Maritime Port Sandbox; Skill Factory; SCM-Cert-Bench
acceptance_evidence: Stored feedback links to episode, artifact, run, or skill scope and is queryable.
notes: Common across deterministic and benchmark systems.

title: Store and query Skill Factory generation, QA, and curation memory
description: Support Skill Factory views keyed by CTT, skill, run, QA, and active-tool status.
source_customers: Skill Factory
acceptance_evidence: Skill Factory tests retrieve generation history, validated facts, and QA decisions through the optional domain pack.
notes: Customer-specific view exposed as an additive MCP domain pack.

title: Provide Skill Factory resources for skills, CTTs, and runs
description: Expose skill, CTT, and run resources for MCP clients.
source_customers: Skill Factory
acceptance_evidence: Resources expose non-sensitive metadata and enforce scope when the domain pack is enabled.
notes: Customer-specific resource templates; disabled outside the pack.

title: Store and query maritime port/run/scenario evidence
description: Persist port facts, admin mutations, and simulation runs with hashes and audit metadata.
source_customers: Maritime Port Sandbox
acceptance_evidence: Queries by run, scenario, port, disruption type, and scope return evidence.

title: Provide maritime resources for runs, scenarios, ports, and facts
description: Expose maritime run, scenario, port, and fact resources.
source_customers: Maritime Port Sandbox
acceptance_evidence: Resources enforce scope and do not expose hidden admin routes.

title: Keep LangChain tools out of customer-facing YAAM contracts
description: Do not require customer systems to integrate through LangChain tools.
source_customers: TRA; iAIMS; Skill Factory; SCM Cognitive Sandwich; Maritime Port Sandbox; SCM-Cert-Bench
acceptance_evidence: Customer-facing docs do not require LangChain tool usage.

description: Avoid direct storage adapters or private YAAM library coupling for customers.

description: Allow temporary facade integration for SCM Cognitive Sandwich while MCP matures.

acceptance_evidence: Migration plan defines facade deprecation or coexistence.

title: Provide contradiction/supersession and safe-refusal review as opt-in
description: Expose contradiction and safe-refusal review explicitly without default autonomous mutation.

notes: Promoted by SCM-Cert-Bench adversarial benchmark MVP need.

title: Provide autonomous consolidation/distillation as opt-in only
description: Keep autonomous lifecycle actions privileged and non-default.
source_customers: Skill Factory; SCM Cognitive Sandwich
acceptance_evidence: Lifecycle tools are not enabled by default for customers.

title: Provide MCP prompt templates for evidence, memory inspection, and CIAR explanation
description: Expose common prompt templates for inspection and audit workflows.
source_customers: iAIMS; Skill Factory; SCM Cognitive Sandwich; Maritime Port Sandbox; SCM-Cert-Bench
acceptance_evidence: Prompt discovery returns documented templates and variables.

description: Provide optional customer/domain prompts such as repair context, repair-pattern summaries, contradiction review, and curation summaries.
source_customers: Skill Factory; SCM Cognitive Sandwich; SCM-Cert-Bench
acceptance_evidence: Domain prompts are optional, scoped to relevant callers, and exposed through MCP domain packs.

title: Preserve fail-fast behavior for write/assimilation failures
description: Mutating flows should fail explicitly instead of silently succeeding with empty or partial writes.
source_customers: TRA; iAIMS; Skill Factory; Maritime Port Sandbox; SCM-Cert-Bench
acceptance_evidence: Failed writes return structured retryable/non-retryable errors.
notes: Read flows may return partial results.

title: Track performance budgets for query, context, evidence, and CIAR operations
description: Record latency budgets for public workflows.
source_customers: iAIMS; Skill Factory; Maritime Port Sandbox; SCM-Cert-Bench
acceptance_evidence: Plans and tests record workflow-level latency budgets.

title: Require implementation plans to reference requirement IDs
description: Require future plans and reports to cite relevant registry IDs.
source_customers: Internal governance
acceptance_evidence: New plans and reports cite registry IDs.

acceptance_evidence: Curation writes return record id, visibility scope, source-triad links, timestamp, and audit id; runtime agents are denied access.
notes: Do not expose curation notes to evaluated agents.
